name: DNS Enumeration
description: Ability to enumerate DNS infrastructure and extract network intelligence from name services. Covers zone transfers, subdomain brute-forcing, reverse DNS sweeps, DNS record analysis, and identification of DNS misconfigurations that may expose internal network information.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to DNS enumeration techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands DNS fundamentals and the security implications of DNS misconfigurations
evidence: Can explain DNS record types (A, AAAA, MX, NS, CNAME, TXT, SRV, PTR)
Understands zone transfers and why they represent a security risk
Knows the role of DNS in network reconnaissance

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic DNS enumeration using standard tools under supervision
evidence: Uses dig, nslookup, or host for DNS queries and record retrieval
Attempts zone transfers against target name servers
Runs subdomain enumeration tools (gobuster, amass, subfinder) with guidance
Documents DNS findings in engagement notes under review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts comprehensive DNS enumeration and identifies attack surface from DNS data
evidence: Performs systematic DNS enumeration including forward and reverse lookups
Discovers hidden subdomains and internal hostnames through multiple techniques
Identifies DNS misconfigurations (open resolvers, DNSSEC issues, zone transfer leaks)
Correlates DNS data with other enumeration findings to map infrastructure

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex DNS environments; develops enumeration automation; mentors others
evidence: Enumerates split-horizon DNS and multi-domain environments
Develops automated DNS enumeration pipelines and wordlists
Identifies DNS-based attack opportunities (poisoning, takeover, tunneling)
Mentors junior staff on DNS enumeration methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines DNS enumeration methodology; deep protocol expertise; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's DNS enumeration standard methodology
Deep understanding of DNS protocol internals and resolution mechanics
Published research on DNS security or enumeration techniques
Trains teams on advanced DNS enumeration and DNS attack surface analysis

assessment_methods.description: Perform comprehensive DNS enumeration against a lab domain and produce a complete record of all discovered hostnames, records, and misconfigurations
Review DNS enumeration results from recent engagements for thoroughness
